tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe zab kyi: cha lag las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: cha lag las kyi mkha' 'gro che: rdo rje sder mo'i sgrub thabs bshad: dur khrod bas mtha'i gnas mchog tu: sgrub rten mchod pa yo byad bcas: sngon 'gro rjes sdud spyi ltar la: dngos gzhi bskyed rim ting 'dzin ni: a: ma skyes rdzogs pa'i ngang nyid las: dbyings ye zung 'jug hūm̐ yig 'bar: e yaṃ raṃ suṃ kiṃ raṃ bhrūm̐: 'byung ba lnga yi klong dkyil du: keng rus ri rab me 'bar rtser: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas su: mtshon cha 'khor lo 'bar ba dang: padma nyi ma dgra bgegs gdan: dur khrod 'bar ba'i 'khor yug dang: mtshon cha 'bar bas gur khang 'khrigs: hūm̐ las las kyi mkha' 'gro ni: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan nas me 'bar srid gsum sreg: zhal nas chu 'khrugs rgya mtsho 'khyil: shangs nas rlung 'khrugs 'jig rten g.yo: ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa pheṃ sgra sgrog: g.yas pas ral gri bsam gcod 'phyar: g.yon pas rdo rje phur bu 'dril: zhabs gnyis gar thabs dgra bgegs brdzis: phyogs bzhir sprul pa'i sras mo bzhi: mthing ser dmar smug 'jigs pa'i sku: rang rtags phyag rgya phur bu 'dril: kun kyang dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: ye shes me yi klong na rol: khyams dang sgo bzhi 'khor yug tu: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag dang: dregs pa sde brgyad rlung ltar 'tshub: sgo gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs: rdo rje gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs: ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hā hūm̐ swā āṃḥ.oṃ: badzra sa mā dza: zhes snyan gsan phab: e hye hi sa spyan drang: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa bstim: kā ya wā ka tsitta tiṣṭha: brtan par byas: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: phyag 'tshal: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā ba linta khā hi: ta na ghā ṇa dharma dhā tu ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes mchod: rgyud bzhin bstod pa bya:

de nas thugs kar nyi ma'i steng: hūm̐ la yang snying dag gis bskor: 'od zer me yi tshwa tshwa 'phros: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs: rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus: 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs bde la bkod: snang srid dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: sku las sku 'phros 'jig rten gang: gsung gi drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: thugs ni sgrol mdzad ye shes 'bar: byad ma lha dang bcas pa dang: bdud bgegs dgra dang dam sri'i tshogs: phur bus gdab cing tho bas brdungs: phyag rgyas mnan cing brlags par bsam: man ngag kun gyi mthar thug go: sa ma yā: dal la ma zhugs dbang med na: dngos grub mi thob brlag par 'gyur: sa yi cho ga sta gon bya: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi 'khor yug bcas: 'khor lo phyag rgya'i sku rnams bri: bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis bkang: bdud rtsi thod pa rig ma dang: phyag rgya'i sku dang bsgral rdzas bsham: dkyil 'khor bskyed cing bum pa bsgrub: dbang blangs snyan gsan dbab nas su: gang 'jug de yis yon phul nas: dkyil 'khor bdag nyid bla ma mchog: ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi dngos: mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dkyil 'khor du: bdag nyid gzhug par mdzod cig gsol: rgyud sbyangs dam 'bogs dbang du bya: bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: don yod grub pas dbu brgyan bsam: oṃ karma mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa āṃ: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bcas: oṃ badzra ghāṣṭe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gsang ba'i mtshan bsgrag bskyed rim bstan: blo chen gsang ba'i dal du bcug: slob dpon yum gyi byang chub sems: dbang thob de yi lce la bzhag: bho dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: a ho ma hā su khaṃ: yum yang slob ma de la sbyin: gsang ba'i brtul zhugs slob par bya: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: snying po brjod cing phyag rgya gtad:

gdab sngags bzlar gzhug sgrol rdzas sbyin: bsnyen sgrub las kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin: sa ma ya: srung ba rdo rje'i brag rdzong ni: stong khams gang ba mtshon cha'i gur: mthing nag gru gsum e yi dbus: sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs dang sri: rdo rje phur bus btab nas su: bum pa nyid du gzhal yas khang: lha dang bcas pa bsgom par bya: 'khor lo 'bar bas dgra srog gcod: rtsibs bzhi 'bar la hūm̐ gis gtams: dbus su bsrung bya 'god par bya: phyi nang sngags kyi grong khyer bkod: mtshon cha me dpung mtha' nas sbar: gdung dang rdo rje gi wang byugs: 'od zer rdo rje'i glog 'khyug pas: rdo rje zhun gyis rab tu sbyar: sa ma ya: zlog pa rdo rje thog zer ni: sprul pa mtshon cha me dpung 'gyed: gang la bya ba'i thog tu bab: phur bus gdab cing tho bas brdung: phyag rgyas mnan cing me yis bsregs: rjes shul tsam yang med par byed: sa ma ya: gsad pa srog gi spu gri ni: e las dmigs bya de tshud nas: rdo rje phur bus bsgral bar bya: yang na gsad pa'i khang bu brtsegs: dgra gzugs dngos su bsam byas la: bkug cing drag sngags thun gyis brab: za byed gsod byed bsnol mar 'khyug: phyag rgya 'bar bas snying khrag dgug: klad pa'i dkyil nas 'khor zhing 'beb: pho nya khrag gis myos par bsam: las grub bla rtags byung dus su: gri lcags phur pa sor bzhis gdab: phung sa'i las khung dug gis bkang: drag po'i me sbar zag pa bsreg: thal ba klu bdud chu gtad bya: lha la sha khrag phul nas su: gtor ma dgra yi phyogs su 'phang: gos brdab dmod pas snying tshim bya: sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba na: lha sgom dmigs bya bkug byas na: sgrib sbyangs skye med dbyings su bstim: dug ri me 'bar sha za ma: gsod pa'i las la grogs byed do: 'on kyang e bag sha ru 'gyur: 'bod pa dzaḥdang rbad pa bhyo: mā ra ya rbad gsad pa'i las: 'di ni gsod pa'i lag cha yin:

zhag bdun dgra bo sgrol ba'i las: yang na las rtsom rgyug 'gyel yin: mang por spel na phung dkrug rgyu: dpe brgyud spel yang bka' brgyud sbos: bstan srung srog gcod nag mo'i skor: gter kha gzhan la spel ba med: de phyir mthu mkhan snying nor 'di: kun mthun kun las khyad par che: byad ma 'bum gyi srog 'phrog pa: drag sngags zab pa ྈྈ'brel: bstan srung 'dod khams dbang mo ni: dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba ru: nag mo rlung gi bong bu zhon: ral gri thod khrag shag ti mdung: thogs nas mi ro rangs por gsol: drel zhon nag mo 'bum gyis bskor: sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo spro: phyag rgya phyag mtshan bdud rtsi sbyin: nyi ma 'bar las bhyoḥyig 'bar: ci dgos las 'grub zhal bstan dmigs: rlung ras dpyang ba nal bu'i snying: gtor ma shin tu rgyas par bya: sku gzugs de la blta bar byed: las kyi brub khung 'bar ba ru: dgra bkug 'bod rbad gsad gsum dbye: lha mo'i gtor ma dgra la 'phen: nag mo 'bum ni las la 'gyed: gtso mo de yi dmod pas brlag: de ni srog las dmar nag go: sa ma ya: dur khrod zhing skyong smug nag 'bar: me long dgra snying lag na thogs: 'khor ni dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: wa spyang dred sogs pho nya 'gyed: oṃ ma ma ra li pra ma ya kā li ye dza dza: hūm̐: he ru ka yi dam nos ngas nus ma: sgyu ma'i gar mdzad 'dod dgu'i 'phrul mo che: dgra bo cham 'beb ltas ngan kun gyi bdag: sgrub mchog rnams kyi dkor gyi srung ma mchog: snying nye bkra shis mthu rtsal thogs pa med: 'dod dgu mchog stsol ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: padma thod phreng rtsal gyi rjes 'jug gi: gnad kyi bka' srung dkor bdag ngas nus ma: rig 'dzin rnams kyi bran mo mthu rtsal can: bran g.yog 'khor slob bzang por skyong ba dang: zas nor phyugs skyongs dkor rkun rtsad nas chod: rta nor srung zhing 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrubs:
zhes gsol phud mchod zas sna 'bul: mda' mo rgod sgro dar sna dang: me long nal snying rlung ras 'phyangs: 'bru sna'i 'di nas lha mos cho 'phrul 'tshub lhong gis phab ma thub par gsung*/
